scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:products" "npm run dev:orders" "npm run dev:notifications"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build:services
scripts.build:shared: cd backend/shared/database && npm run build && cd ../types && npm run build && cd ../utils && npm run build
scripts.build:services: cd backend/services/auth-service && npm run build && cd ../product-service && npm run build && cd ../order-service && npm run build && cd ../notification-service && npm run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:frontend: cd frontend/apps/web && npm install && cd ../admin && npm install && cd ../../packages/ui && npm install && cd ../types && npm install && cd ../utils && npm install
scripts.install:backend: cd backend/shared/database && npm install && cd ../types && npm install && cd ../utils && npm install && cd ../../services/auth-service && npm install && cd ../product-service && npm install && cd ../order-service && npm install && cd ../notification-service && npm install
